diagnosis.cause: The gateway created each link attempt with HTTP 201, but the typed browser client declared only HTTP 200. The client rejected the successful response before storing the attempt or navigating to authorization.
diagnosis.manifest: The manifest omitted credentials, causing Cloudflare Access to redirect its request to a different origin. The manifest link now requests credentials.

regressions.name: helper landing with actual 201 status
regressions.before: failed: stayed on Settings instead of navigating to authorization

regressions.name: manifest behind session-cookie protection
regressions.after: passed on desktop and mobile; browser sends HttpOnly session cookie and parses actual manifest

browser.mode: built PWA; mocked application API and cookie-protected manifest fixture

cases.name: built-browser-accepts-real-next-201-and-navigates-to-authorization
cases.mode: built browser with actual next responses through private verification RPC; navigation stopped before consent

admission.prerequisite: Owner consent, account model discovery and a real subscription-backed streamed Responses request remain required. The browser smoke stopped before authorization and cancelled its attempt.
